text:
3 things I'd never paste into any AI chat, Claude included.

Not because AI is evil. A chat is saved on a company's servers, like an email.

The list is in the thread below.
descendants:
1. Passwords and login codes.

No real task needs them. If anything asks you to paste a password into a chat, close it.

2. Full card, bank or Social Security numbers.

Black them out before you upload a statement. AI reads the charges just fine with ████ where the numbers were.

3. Other people's private details.

A client's health info, a coworker's address. Use initials or "Client A". The answer is just as good.

Everything else, like bills, leases, emails and resumes, is where AI saves you hours. Save this.

text:
You're probably paying for a subscription you forgot about.

The app you opened once. A second streaming service. A free trial that quietly turned paid.

Upload 3 months of bank statements to Claude (black out the account numbers) and type:
"Find every recurring charge and what I save by canceling."

It lists each one with the yearly cost, then writes the cancel messages.

No need to comment. Free guide: https://autopilotoi.app/g/subs/

Money you might be owed right now:

A double charge on your card.
An order that never showed up.
A flight the airline canceled.

Flights: if a US airline cancels and you turn down the new one, DOT rules say you get your money back, not just a voucher.

Paste the receipt into Claude and ask for a short refund request that names your rights.

No need to comment. Free guide: https://autopilotoi.app/g/refund/
